data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme investing in small cap stocks.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation from a portfolio that is invested predominantly in equity and equity related securities of small-cap companies. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity related instruments of small cap companies - 65-100% Equity & Equity related instruments of other than small cap companies - 0-35% Debt Securities & Money Market instruments (including Cash & cash equivalents, TREPS) - 0-35% Units issued by REITs and INVITs - 0-10%
data.benchmark: Nifty Small Cap 250 Total Return Index (TRI)
data.fund_managers: FM1 - Mr. Alok Bahl; FM2 - Mr. Pratik Singh
data.exit_load: (i) If units redeemed or switched out within 3 months from the date of allotment – 1% of the applicable NAV (ii) If redeemed/switched out after 3 months from the date of allotment – Nil
